response.sql: WITH station AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS st_avg FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(st_avg) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS station_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station) AS station_fraction FROM station GROUP BY lunarstage
